question: Can a CALMem-inspired episodic strategy improve long-range conversational recall over a recent window while using less cumulative context than bounded history replay?
scope_note: Gate 1 only. This registration does not authorize runtime integration, semantic memory, cross-conversation memory, Gate 2, or Gate 3.

dataset.replay: teacher-forced fixed-prefix; candidate answers never advance the transcript or enter the index

instrument.generation_mode: streaming ProviderPort call for TTFT; one attempt; experiment-only string-content serializer required because the unchanged production Responses serializer returned HTTP 400 for assistant-history input

generation_request_snapshot.max_output_tokens: not sent because the current provider contract does not enforce it

instrument.output_cap: not enforced by the current OpenAI adapter

calibration.selection_method: first retain only zero-isolation candidates where D1, D2_JSON, and D2_TEXT each meet the proposed irrelevance, duplicate-slot, and superseded-retrieval ceilings; then maximize their mean message Recall@k, mean MRR, and mean delivered unique-source recall; minimize mean irrelevance, mean duplicate slots, mean query tokens, chunk size, overlap, active N, top-k, and threshold in that order
calibration.arm_order: deterministic rotation of A,B,C,D1,D2_JSON,D2_TEXT by evaluation-step ordinal and repetition
calibration.query_selection_rule: select exactly once from corrected development evidence by lexicographically maximizing unrounded fact consistency, conversational recall, ambiguous-followup recall, and exact-identifier recall; then minimizing mean logical standalone API cost, irrelevant injection, superseded retrieval, repeated-source amplification, and mean query tokens; an exact tie resolves to D1, then D2_TEXT, then D2_JSON; after approval the selected arm alone determines GO/STOP and other query arms are diagnostic only
calibration.secondary_query_escalation_rule: a held-out advantage by the diagnostic arm cannot replace the selected arm or rescue STOP; it may only motivate a separately approved, newly pre-registered query-design iteration

primary_metrics.retrieval_unit: source_message_id after truncating to retrieval_top_k_chunks; no backfill
primary_metrics.echo_formula: maximum word-trigram Jaccard overlap between candidate answer and prior assistant/memory text
primary_metrics.repeated_source_amplification_formula: irrelevant unique source messages repeated from the immediately preceding evaluated query in the same conversation divided by irrelevant unique sources delivered after the first evaluated query; zero when the denominator is zero
primary_metrics.break_even_formula: earliest exchange where D cumulative logical API cost is no greater than B and remains no greater through the final exchange; null when no such exchange exists
primary_metrics.cost_basis: per-arm logical standalone cost; physical sharing disclosed separately

paired_evaluation.nested_repetition_reduction: arithmetic mean within each step and arm before conversation aggregation
paired_evaluation.conversation_reduction: arithmetic mean of unrounded step values within each conversation
paired_evaluation.primary_comparison: the development-selected memory query arm minus C
paired_evaluation.confidence_bound_decision: minimum_d_over_c_recall_improvement requires both its unrounded point estimate to meet the registered 0.20 threshold and the conversation-clustered paired selected-memory-arm-minus-C recall one_sided_ci95_low to be greater than zero
paired_evaluation.point_estimate_decision: Every listed criterion is decided from its unrounded held-out point estimate; no confidence bound is substituted or inferred for those criteria.
paired_evaluation.small_slice_rule: report exact unrounded point aggregates without a bootstrap interval; registered slice thresholds remain conjunctive
paired_evaluation.rounding_rule: evaluate all clauses on unrounded machine values; round only presentation values
paired_evaluation.decision_combination: all numeric thresholds, the confidence rule, and every automatic no-go clause must pass

automatic_no_go: conversation-clustered paired selected-memory-arm-minus-C recall one_sided_ci95_low not greater than zero
invalid_run_conditions: any missing held-out evaluation step, arm, or repetition
any failed or unknown-outcome API call
an instrument, dataset, configuration, or artifact failure that prevents a complete valid evaluation
decision_rule.approval_evidence: Explicit operator approval in the ORQ-27 session to freeze this pre-registration and execute the held-out exactly once, subject to the declared confidence-bound and invalid-run policies.

reporting.physical_logical_reconciliation: every physical API invocation must appear in the append-only ledger; logical standalone D1/D2_JSON/D2_TEXT costs and physically shared experiment spend are reported separately and never silently equated

heldout_attempt_policy.attempt_start: an attempt is reserved immediately before the first external API call; the potentially billable boundary is the corresponding started event in execution-ledger.jsonl
heldout_attempt_policy.replacement_rule: Only the first attempt may authorize one complete replacement, and only for a listed eligible accidental provider failure. The replacement receives a new run_id and reruns the full held-out split without reusing partial responses.
heldout_attempt_policy.exhaustion_rule: A second invalid attempt is terminal and cannot be repeated without a new explicit operator decision and a new pre-registration.
heldout_attempt_policy.no_repeat_rule: GO, NO_GO, an isolation failure, a registered threshold failure, a non-eligible invalid run, an unresolved started attempt, or a completed valid run can never be repeated under this registration.
heldout_attempt_policy.cost_rule: Invalid-attempt API calls remain in the physical append-only execution ledger and are reported separately; they do not enter the logical strategy estimates or the quality metrics of the replacement valid run.
